page_title: EIN 1-0 HEI | Eintracht Frankfurt v Heidenheim 14/03/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The match has just finished.
90+3' It's time for a substitution. Oscar Hojlund (Eintracht Frankfurt) comes on in place of Jean-Matteo Bahoya.
90+2' The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Eintracht Frankfurt.
90+1' Good movement by Mathias Honsak (Heidenheim), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Eintracht Frankfurt.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
90' Some great controlled play and passing from Heidenheim. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
88' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Love Arrhov (Eintracht Frankfurt) comes onto the pitch for Ritsu Doan.
88' Heidenheim have been awarded a corner kick.

88' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Heidenheim. Omar Haktab Traore (Heidenheim) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the bottom left corner, but Michael Zetterer was alert and made a comfortable save.
85' Heidenheim keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
84' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Marnon Busch departs the field of play to be replaced by Omar Haktab Traore (Heidenheim).
83' Ritsu Doan (Eintracht Frankfurt) will take a corner kick.
82' This is a yellow card! Michael Zetterer (Eintracht Frankfurt) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
80' Albert Riera has decided to make a change. Elias Baum (Eintracht Frankfurt) replaces Fares Chaibi.
80' It will be a substitution. Jonathan Burkardt (Eintracht Frankfurt) is ready to enter the pitch as Ayoube Amaimouni walks off.
80' Albert Riera has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Ellyes Skhiri (Eintracht Frankfurt) replacing Arnaud Kalimuendo.
80' A substitution has been made. Budu Zivzivadze goes off and Stefan Schimmer (Heidenheim) comes on.
80' The substitution is prepared. Mathias Honsak (Heidenheim) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Luca Kerber.

79' Ayoube Amaimouni (Eintracht Frankfurt) latches onto the ball after a scramble in the box, but his placed effort towards the left side of the goal is far too weak and Diant Ramaj makes a simple save.
75' A poor finish by Ritsu Doan (Eintracht Frankfurt) as he misdirects his shot well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Heidenheim will have a goal kick.
73' Harm Osmers shows a yellow card to Robin Koch (Eintracht Frankfurt) for his blatant foul.
73' Eren Dinkci (Heidenheim) beats the defender to the ball in the box and shoots, but the ball flashes over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Eintracht Frankfurt will have a goal kick.
71' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Eren Dinkci (Heidenheim) was quite harsh and Harm Osmers didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
70' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Heidenheim due to an offside in the build-up play.
69' Wait! Referee Harm Osmers has indicated he is going to review the Heidenheim goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.

68' GOAL! A great pass finds Sirlord Conteh (Heidenheim) in acres of space after a fine counter attack. He brings the ball under control before firing it past the helpless keeper from mid range. It’s now 1:1.
67' Eintracht Frankfurt are seeing far more of the ball now.
66' Heidenheim have a corner.
65' Dangerous play by Benedikt Gimber (Heidenheim). Harm Osmers blows his whistle for a foul.
63' Frank Schmidt decides to make a substitution. Arijon Ibrahimovic will be replaced by Sirlord Conteh (Heidenheim).
63' Frank Schmidt is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Niklas Dorsch (Heidenheim) suffers an injury and Mikkel Kaufmann Sorensen comes on.
59' Foul! Marnon Busch (Heidenheim) is penalised for pulling back his opponent.
57' Niklas Dorsch (Heidenheim) has tested the patience of referee Harm Osmers and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
56' Eintracht Frankfurt are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
53' 1 - 0 Goal! Arnaud Kalimuendo (Eintracht Frankfurt) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot inside the right post. He makes it 1:0.
52' Marnon Busch (Heidenheim) is penalised for holding. Harm Osmers signals a set piece.
50' Ritsu Doan (Eintracht Frankfurt) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort miles over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Heidenheim will have a goal kick.

49' Ritsu Doan (Eintracht Frankfurt) fires the ball towards goal from just outside the penalty area, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar after coming very close to hitting the roof of the net. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Heidenheim.
46' Referee Harm Osmers blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+1' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
44' The ball goes behind for a corner. Eintracht Frankfurt will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
44' The resulting set piece from Eintracht Frankfurt is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players. The ball goes out of play and Eintracht Frankfurt have been awarded a corner kick.
41' Ayoube Amaimouni (Eintracht Frankfurt) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Diant Ramaj, who smothers the ball.
38' Robin Koch (Eintracht Frankfurt) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.

38' Robin Koch (Eintracht Frankfurt) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Harm Osmers with no other option than to blow for a foul.
35' Eintracht Frankfurt string together a series of short passes.
31' Hennes Behrens (Heidenheim) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Michael Zetterer intercepts the ball.
29' Eintracht Frankfurt hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
27' Nnamdi Collins (Eintracht Frankfurt) sends the ball into the penalty area from a throw-in as if it's a corner kick.
25' Ritsu Doan (Eintracht Frankfurt) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
25' A cross from Ayoube Amaimouni (Eintracht Frankfurt) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. Corner kick. Eintracht Frankfurt will have an opportunity.
23' The Eintracht Frankfurt players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
22' Arijon Ibrahimovic (Heidenheim) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
21' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Heidenheim.
21' Luca Kerber (Heidenheim) has the ability to send the ball deep into the penalty area from throw-ins and it can lead to very promising situations for his team.
18' Ritsu Doan (Eintracht Frankfurt) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
15' Eintracht Frankfurt are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
14' Arijon Ibrahimovic (Heidenheim) takes the corner.
13' Hugo Larsson (Eintracht Frankfurt) strikes the ball towards goal from the middle of the penalty area, but his shot goes straight into the gloves of the goalkeeper.
9' Some patient build-up play from Eintracht Frankfurt as they look to unlock the defence.
6' Eintracht Frankfurt keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
4' Referee Harm Osmers sees the trip by Niklas Dorsch (Heidenheim) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. Eintracht Frankfurt are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
3' Marnon Busch (Heidenheim) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee.

1' Eintracht Frankfurt hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
1' The first half has just begun.
Harm Osmers will supervise the game today.
